svg.title: KDS
svg.desc: Postcard for KDS (healthcare web app, Python): Turns hospital data into dashboards and reports for managers and doctors. 18 modules: clinics, revenue, stock, radiology and more. Reads hospital system data from SQL Server. Plotly dashboards and AES-256 encrypted storage. Built with Python, Flask, SQL Server, pyodbc, pandas, Plotly, Waitress.
